title: Beginner Step with a Bass Beat | Step Dance

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates the base rhythm step by step with spoken counts, breaks down the main step separately, and then combines them at a slow tempo before speeding up.

practices.what: The teacher introduces the base beat with stomps and claps while counting out loud.
The teacher adds the left stomp and clap to the base rhythm sequence.
The teacher introduces the actual step that needs to be combined with the base beat.
The teacher puts the combined routine together starting slow and then picking up tempo.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself and his assistant, and explains that they will teach a beginner level routine combining a step with a base beat.
The teacher breaks down the base beat step-by-step, starting with single stomps and hand claps before building up the rhythm.

struggles.theme: going too fast in the end combination
confused by mirror effect / right and left sides

clicked.theme: helpful and easy to follow step-by-step instruction

requests.theme: ask for more step videos and tutorials

meant.theme: helped with school step teams and auditions

method.limits: Audio quality and instructor positioning do not show close-ups of footwork details.
